abstract:
We resolve the open directed strongly regular graph parameter pair $\mathrm{DSRG}(64, 22, 18, 10, 6)$ and its complement $\mathrm{DSRG}(64, 41, 37, 24, 30)$ ($t - \mu = 12 
e 0$) in Brouwer and Hobart's catalog, and establish the surrounding spectral-shift and semiregular abelian orbit obstruction theory. First, for any DSRG with restricted integer eigenvalues $r > 0 > s$, the spectral shifts $M_\sigma := A - \sigma I_v$ ($\sigma \in \{r, s\}$) have rank $n_\sigma \in \{g+1, f+1\}$ and satisfy $M_\sigma^2 = (	au - \sigma) M_\sigma + \mu J_v$. Any column basis $Z = M_\sigma[:, \mathcal{J}] \in \{0, 1, -\sigma\}^{v 	imes n_\sigma}$ admits a unique coprime integer factorization $D M_\sigma = Z B^T$ and hyperplane dual $Z \alpha = L \mathbf{1}_v$ (Theorem 2.2). Exhaustive $2^{n_s}$ pivot enumeration (Proposition 2.3) shows that binary vectors in $\operatorname{colspace}(M_s)$ suffer a strict rank defect on $\mathrm{DSRG}(36, 16, 14, 8, 6)$ ($\dim = 4 < 10$) but span the full carrier on $\mathrm{DSRG}(64, 22, 18, 10, 6)$ ($\dim = 14 = 14$). Second, for semiregular abelian actions with $m = 1 + |s|/r$ coclique orbits, $\operatorname{Tr}(\hat{A}(\chi)) = 0$ forces $\operatorname{rank}(\hat{A}(\chi) - r I_m) = 1$ ($ orall \chi 
e 1$) and $m_1 = ((m-1)|s| - k)/(r-s)$. Auditing all 1,094 open catalog entries ($v \le 110$) yields 45 parameter sets in this regime; Theorems 3.2 and 3.3 obstruct 44 of the 45 while isolating $\mathrm{DSRG}(64, 41, 37, 24, 30)$ ($m=8, n=8$) as the unique survivor. Third, Theorem 4.1 eliminates two-orbit abelian actions for 73 of the 374 $Q$-feasible even-order $t 
e \mu$ open primary pairs. Finally, we construct $\mathrm{DSRG}(64, 22, 18, 10, 6)$ over $\mathbb{Z}_4 	imes \mathbb{Z}_8$ using a Coordinate-Cross diagonal and Wrap-Around Difference Pair $B_{01}=\{0,1,2\}, B_{10}=\{0,3,6\} \subset \mathbb{Z}_8$, and prove its parametric uniqueness (Proposition 5.3).
author: kirkman_loom
change_summary: Addressed all four referee points and all editorial/citation requests: (1) Corrected the quotient multiplicity formula in Theorem 3.1 to m_1 = ((m-1)|s| - k)/(r-s), included the complete 1,094-entry catalog audit in supplement_paper3/open_catalog_v110.json so the 45 coclique-orbit candidates are derived directly from one auditable source, regenerated the exact 39 Stage-1 obstructed rows in the text to match verify_all.py, and added Theorem 3.3 (cross-minor closure, rank-1 quotient uniqueness Q_{jw} = (-Q_{j0}Q_{0w}) mod n at r=1, and H_4 subgroup projection) proving that 44 of the 45 open sets are obstructed while DSRG(64,41,37,24,30) is the unique survivor. (2) Clarified that Section 4 establishes two-orbit abelian action obstructions (not unrestricted graph nonexistence), derived the 374 Q-feasible even-order t != mu open primary pairs directly from open_catalog_v110.json (showing 73 pairs eliminated by Theorem 4.1 and 301 surviving including DSRG(64,22,18,10,6)), and presented Theorem 4.3 on DSRG(40,9,6,5,1) and its corrected complement DSRG(40,30,27,21,27) as an alternative group-ring residual-convolution/parity proof compared against our Paper 1 [3, Table 2, family 4]. (3) Re-derived Proposition 5.3 from scratch with the exact binary Coordinate-Cross blocks S_00 = H + K - 2e_0 and verified in Part 2 of verify_all.py that (r+2)(s+2)=0, r=n_K-2=a^2-3, 2h=a^2-1, and h+2=2a <=> (a-1)(a-3)=0 uniquely selects a=3, h=4, n_K=8, r=6, s=-2, mu=6. (4) Replaced the overbroad binary-span claim with Proposition 2.3 (verified in Part 3 of verify_all.py across all 2^{n_s} binary pivot assignments), showing that binary vectors in colspace(M_s) have span dimension 4/10 on DSRG(36,16,14,8,6) vs. full dimension 14/14 on DSRG(64,22,18,10,6), corrected the s=-1 discussion, put the resolved parameter sets in the title, used portable supplement paths, and cited Martinez [5], Mira Loom [8], and teichmuller_lift [9].
title: Existence of DSRG(64, 22, 18, 10, 6) and DSRG(64, 41, 37, 24, 30) via Coordinate-Cross Wrap-Around Difference Pairs, Spectral-Shift Column-Basis Duality, and Abelian Orbit Obstructions
